items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund and Life Insurance Vacation and Parental Leave Internet and Electricity Allowance Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-sr-data-analytics-engineer-r14153

items.description: All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description. About JumpCloud® JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times. JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT. About the Role We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to join JumpCloud’s Cloud Platform organization, with a focus on observability and FinOps. You’ll own the questions that matter most as we scale toward 99.99% availability: can we see what’s happening across the platform, how fast do we recover when something breaks, can we survive a regional outage, and are we spending enough to run it all? This is a hands-on staff role. You’ll set the technical direction for observability, incident management, disaster recovery, and cloud cost, write the code and AI-driven automation that make it real, and work closely with engineering, customer support, finance, and leadership. What You’ll Be Doing Observability Set the technical direction for observability across JumpCloud’s cloud platform: metrics, logs, traces, and events, on AWS and GCP. Build and run our observability stack (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry), including standard instrumentation libraries and collectors that teams adopt by default. Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with service owners, and build the dashboards and burn-rate alerts that hold us to a 99.99% SLA. Cut alert noise. Make sure every page is actionable, routed to the right owner, and backed by a runbook. Shorten detection and recovery times (MTTD and MTTR) by improving tracing, correlation, and incident tooling. Manage observability cost itself: cardinality, log volume, sampling, and retention, so visibility grows without the bill growing with it. FinOps Own cloud cost visibility: tagging standards, cost allocation by team and service, and showback reports that engineers actually read. Find and deliver savings through right-sizing, autoscaling, spot capacity, storage tiering, idle-resource cleanup, and data-transfer reduction. Shape our commitment strategy (Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, committed-use discounts) with finance, based on real usage data. Build automation and guardrails, such as budget alerts, anomaly detection, and policy-as-code checks, that catch waste before it ships. Define unit economics, like cost per customer or per device, and make cost a normal input to design reviews. Partner with finance on forecasting and budgeting, and explain cloud spend clearly to leadership. Incident Management and AI-Driven Automation Own the incident management process end to end: severity levels, on-call rotations, escalation paths, communication, and the tooling behind them. Lead major incidents as incident commander or senior escalation point, and keep customers and leadership informed. Run root cause analysis (RCA) for significant incidents, and drive the follow-up actions to completion so issues don’t repeat. Build AI agents that correlate alerts, logs, traces, and recent changes to find the likely root cause automatically. Build self-healing automation and AI agents that detect and fix known issues before they escalate or reach customers, with safe guardrails and human approval where it matters. Measure and improve incident health over time: MTTD, MTTR, repeat incidents, and on-call load. Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Own JumpCloud’s business continuity (BCP) and disaster recovery (DR) strategy for the cloud platform. Define RTO and RPO targets with product and leadership, and design the architecture to meet them. Design and build the DR site and recovery environment across AWS and GCP, including data replication, backups, failover, and failback. Plan and run regular DR tests and failover drills, document the results, and close the gaps they reveal. Keep DR runbooks, recovery automation, and BCP plans current, and support audit and customer requests for evidence. Across Everything Write production-quality Go or Python for tooling, exporters, data pipelines, and automation. Work closely with customer support teams: turn support tickets and escalations into monitoring, alerts, and fixes, and give support the visibility they need to answer customers quickly. Partner with product engineering teams on reliability, recoverability, and cost-aware design. Write design docs, review architecture across engineering, and mentor engineers on observability and cost-aware design. We’re Looking For 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 4 years in platform, SRE, or infrastructure roles running 24 ⁄ 7 SaaS systems at scale. Observability depth: You’ve designed and run observability at scale with Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry. You know how to instrument services, set meaningful SLOs, and build alerts people trust. FinOps track record: You’ve cut cloud spend in a measurable way, and you can show the numbers. You’re comfortable with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, Kubecost, or similar tools, and with commitment planning. Strong coding skills: You’ve built production tooling and automation in Go or Python, not just dashboards and scripts. AWS, GCP, and Terraform: strong hands-on production experience with both AWS and GCP, and with Terraform for infrastructure as code. Production Kubernetes experience is expected. Incident management: You’ve owned on-call and incident processes, led major incidents, and run RCAs that led to lasting fixes. AI and automation: You’ve built automation for incident response or remediation, and you have hands-on experience building AI agents or LLM-based tools for root cause analysis or auto-remediation. BCP and DR: You’ve designed and tested disaster recovery for production SaaS systems, including RTO and RPO targets, DR sites, replication, and failover drills. Engineering and customer focus: You have a software engineering background and have worked closely with customer support teams to resolve issues and reduce customer impact. Staff-level influence: You’ve driven change across multiple teams without direct authority, and you can get engineers to care about both reliability and cost. Clear communication with engineers, finance, and leadership. You can turn usage and cost data into a simple story and a clear decision. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. A strong team player who lives our core values: building connections, thinking big, and getting 1% better every day. Preferred Qualifications FinOps Certified Practitioner, or hands-on experience applying the FinOps Framework. Experience with cost tools such as CloudHealth, Vantage, Cloudability, or AWS Compute Optimizer. Experience building cost and usage data pipelines (AWS CUR, BigQuery billing export, Athena) and reporting on top of them. Experience running observability in-house at scale (Prometheus/Thanos/Mimir, Loki, Tempo) and weighing that against SaaS vendors. Experience with eBPF-based monitoring, continuous profiling, or real user monitoring. Experience negotiating or managing vendor contracts for observability or cloud spend. Open-source contributions, published writing, or conference talks on observability or FinOps. #LI-PD1 Where you’ll be working/Location: JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description. You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role. Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don’t go unaddressed. Language: JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description. Why JumpCloud? If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. One of JumpCloud’s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating “ human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed.” - Rajat Bhargava, CEO Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time. JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Scam Notice: Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment. All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at [email protected] with the subject line “Scam Notice” #LI-Remote #BI-Remote We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) About the Role: Maven is looking for a Director of Marketing Operations who will own the systems, data, and reporting infrastructure behind our B2B Growth Marketing team — from HubSpot/Salesforce instrumentation to pipeline attribution to the budget that funds it all. This person will lead a team across marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization, and serve as the go-to partner for Sales, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data and reporting. Reporting to the Senior Director of Growth, they'll bring structure and rigor to a fast-moving org, ensuring marketing's numbers hold up in front of executive leadership. What You’ll Do: Marketing Technology, Data & Attribution HubSpot instrumentation (and its integration with Salesforce): own lead management strategy, campaign orchestration and tracking, and stage definitions for the B2B funnel. Pipeline attribution: own marketing's multi-touch attribution methodology and represent it in cross-team pipeline conversations. Data governance: maintain data dictionaries and definitions (MQL/MQA thresholds, pipeline vs. bookings vs. revenue) so reporting stays consistent as tools and AI use expand. Martech stack: own B2B-facing tools and integrations, including CaliberMind, GA4, HubSpot, Qualified, Webflow, and evaluate new tooling as needs evolve. Training and enablement: ensure the has the resources and knowledge to own the reporting and orchestration of their channels. Analytics & Reporting KPI ownership: define and maintain B2B marketing metrics (MQLs, MQAs, pipeline coverage, Pipe-Spend ratio) and the reporting cadence behind them. Executive reporting: build and deliver pipeline briefings and performance readouts for B2B marketing leadership. Dashboards: own the B2B analytics stack across CaliberMind, Looker, Data Studio, Salesforce, and GA4, and keep it accurate as definitions change. FY planning support: partner with Strategic Finance and RevOps on fiscal year target-setting, run-rate projections, and scenario modeling for B2B pipeline and budget as well as org-level OKR setting. Budget & Planning Budget ownership: oversee the B2B marketing budget, including forecast, actuals, monthly reconciliation, and shifts across programs and months. Vendor management: track spend and manage relationships with external vendors. FY planning: lead annual and quarterly budgeting and planning for B2B Growth Marketing in partnership with Strategic Finance. Marketing Website & CRO Marketing website: manage the web team that owns navigation, landing pages, and on-page SEO/AEO for the Enterprise/B2B experience. Testing and optimization: run a structured A/B testing and CRO program for B2B landing pages. Accessibility: maintain WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across the B2B site experience. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnership People leadership: manage and develop a team covering marketing analytics, marketing operations, and web optimization. Process and tooling: set the team's operating rhythm and own its project management tooling (Asana and Jira). Builds with AI: personally build AI-powered workflows for reporting, analysis, and campaign operations that enable the team to make better decisions and scale without additional headcount. AI enablement: lead rollout of AI tools within B2B Growth Marketing, including data governance for tools connected to live CRM and marketing data, and set the team's judgment for where AI helps and where it doesn't. Cross-functional partnership: serve as B2B Growth Marketing's primary point of contact for Sales, SDR, RevOps, Strategic Finance, and Client Success on shared data, process, and reporting questions. What You’ll Bring: 8+ years in B2B marketing operations, analytics, or revenue operations, ideally supporting complex or enterprise sales cycles. Hands-on ownership of a marketing automation platform (HubSpot or similar) and the integration with Salesforce, including lead routing, lifecycle stages, and campaign orchestration. Experience building and defending pipeline or marketing attribution models with Sales and Finance stakeholders. Track record owning multi-million dollar marketing budgets, including forecasting, actuals, and reconciliation. Experience owning a B2B marketing website and CRO program, including A/B testing and accessibility standards. Experience managing and developing a high performance team. Sharp, direct communicator, comfortable presenting pipeline and Marketing performance data to executive leadership. Comfortable operating in a fast-changing org structure and building processes from ambiguity. Experience rolling out AI tools within a marketing team, with an eye toward data governance and accuracy. The base salary range for this role is $170,000 - $200,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset. This role requires active work authorization in the US. Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, and remotely via San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, Seattle, WA. For those in our New York City office, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to work onsite three days a week (Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday). For those based in Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco, we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend monthly Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-director-marketing-operations

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - MX Who We Are Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually. The Opportunity As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects). At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in. What You'll Do Your day-to-day You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs. You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data. You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security. You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions. You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices. You’ll implement monitoring and observability practices to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and strengthen platform reliability. You’ll provide technical leadership on architecture, scalability, reliability, monitoring, integration, and extensibility. You’ll lead and contribute to code reviews, helping maintain high standards for code quality, performance, and maintainability. You’ll mentor junior engineers and support a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. You’ll take ownership of production issues, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, escalation, and long-term resolution. You’ll independently lead multiple features and projects, coordinate work across engineers, and keep stakeholders informed of progress, risks, and dependencies. You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working. You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving. Who You Are The right fit looks like this You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions. What You Bring Skills & experience Required 8+ years of experience in data engineering, with strong experience in data architecture, ETL, and database management. Strong programming skills in Python or PySpark, plus experience with Java or Scala. Experience building complex end-to-end data pipelines and data integration solutions. Strong knowledge of SQL and experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies. Experience with big data technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, or similar platforms. Experience with orchestration and scheduling tools such as Airflow, Databricks, Jenkins, or similar technologies. Experience designing and operating scalable, reliable, and secure data systems. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and associated data services. Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Lean, or Kanban. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills. Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership within a team. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams. Nice to Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field. Databricks experience or certification. Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services. Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks. Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity. Our AI Mindset We build with AI. We lead with judgment. AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work. We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting , willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle. In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together. Why Oportun What's in it for you Oportun offers a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and professional well-being. Benefits vary by country of employment. Some of the benefits available to eligible employees include: Mexico Benefits: Medical Insurance Savings Fund Life Insurance Internet and Electricity Allowance Paid time off such as vacation and parental leave Eligibility and plan details vary by location and employment status. To learn more about Oportun and our benefits, visit oportun.com/careers #LI-REMOTE #LI-GK1 We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment opportunities without regard to race, age, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other category protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. California applicants can find a copy of Oportun's CCPA Notice here: https://oportun.com/privacy/california-privacy-notice/ . We will never request personal identifiable information (bank, credit card, etc.) before you are hired. We do not charge you for pre-employment fees such as background checks, training, or equipment. If you think you have been a victim of fraud by someone posing as us, please report your experience to the FBI’s Internet Crime Complaint Center (IC3). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oportun-senior-data-engineer-capital-markets-r13923

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline. We want someone who can show what they have personally built with AI, how it changed their workflow or capacity, and what measurable impact it had on data quality, speed, conversion, revenue, or headcount efficiency. What You'll Own HubSpot end-to-end: object model (contacts, companies, workspaces, deals, tickets), lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, workflows, and permissions, with one owner per field and every critical workflow tested and monitored The revenue data layer (built with our engineering and data team): the app, Stripe, and HubSpot feeding PostHog, with shared definitions for trial, paid, MRR, churn, expansion, and reactivation that every report uses Funnel instrumentation and attribution: source captured at signup, account qualification by measured ad spend, and a clear trail from first touch to trial to paid to renewal AI-powered RevOps systems at scale: build and operate workflows where AI materially increases throughput across enrichment, routing, lead and account scoring, health scoring, data hygiene, and reporting. You should be able to demonstrate systems you have personally built and the business results they produced. The weekly revenue scorecard for the leadership meeting, pulled from source data; and the operating processes behind sales and customer success: quote and discount approvals, agency account handovers, refunds, chargebacks, and failed-payment recovery. You're a Fit If You've personally rebuilt a CRM that a revenue team relied on, and you can show the before and after: workflows fixed, fields retired, duplicate records merged, and reports leadership started to trust. You have built real AI-powered workflows and can show what you built, where AI sat in the workflow, what it automated or augmented, and the measurable impact it created. You understand subscription revenue well enough to reconcile MRR between Stripe and the CRM, and to explain why the two numbers differ Hands-on with HubSpot (Operations Hub or equivalent), SQL, CLI, API’s, Webhooks, n8n/Make, and Claude Code or Codex You can explain lifecycle stages, deal pipelines, and attribution models without Googling You treat product usage as revenue data: trial activity, connected ad accounts, and plan limits feed scoring and routing You're Not a Fit If Your experience is mostly building dashboards on top of data someone else had to fix You measure success in workflows built and tickets closed rather than conversion and revenue You need a team around you; this role is the builder for our foundation Required Skills & Experience 3-5+ Years in RevOps or Revenue Systems: Proven experience owning the CRM and revenue data for a B2B SaaS company, ideally one with a self-serve trial or product-led motion. You can show the numbers: data completeness, workflow reliability, funnel conversion, forecast accuracy, and time saved. CRM Architecture: Concrete experience designing an object model, lifecycle stages, and pipelines from scratch, or rebuilding a broken one, including migrations that keep the history intact. You document every field you create and retire the ones nobody uses. Data Ownership: You have personally owned the path from source system to report: event tracking, warehouse tables, SQL, and reconciliation against billing. When two systems disagree, you find out why before anyone reports the number. AI-Native Execution: You have personally built AI-powered systems inside a revenue workflow, including enrichment, scoring, routing, classification, data cleanup, forecasting, or agentic workflows. You can clearly explain what you built, why you built it, how it worked, and what measurable result it produced in terms of pipeline, revenue, productivity, speed, quality, or reduced manual work. Full-Funnel Accountability: You measure your work through the full chain from signup → trial → qualified account → paid → renewal → expansion. You can show examples where a process you built moved conversion or retention. You are comfortable killing your own workflows when the data says they are not helping. Cross-Team Range: Ability to work with sales, customer success, marketing, finance, and engineering: you write specs an engineer can build from and processes a sales rep will follow. Technical Proficiency HubSpot CRM Ecosystem: (Expert Level) Custom objects, associations, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, properties, lists, permissions, and the HubSpot API. SQL & Product Analytics: (Working Level) Comfortable writing SQL against a warehouse (PostHog or equivalent) and joining product events with billing and CRM data. Billing Systems: Working fluency with Stripe: subscriptions, invoices, coupons, failed payments, and how each one shows up in MRR. Enrichment & Data APIs: Clay or equivalent, people and company data providers, and comfort consuming REST APIs and webhooks directly. Automation Engineering: Strong execution knowledge of workflow automation (n8n, Make, or native AI-agent integrations) and AI coding tools (Claude Code or Codex), connecting the stack without engineering support. Logistics Remote, async-first team culture. Must have overlapping availability for live syncs between 7 AM and 2 PM EST . Full-time, long-term position. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/clickguard-inc-revops-manager

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: United Kingdom (Remote) Who we are Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot. We’re excited to hire someone based in London , where we’re looking to grow our sales presence. About The Role Our team is still early in its evolution, operating with a start-up mindset within a scaling company. We're building stronger processes, a clearer operating model, and the foundation for our next stage of growth. We’re looking for someone who wants to help create that future—not just operate within it. As a Senior Account Executive reporting directly to the Head of Sales, you’ll be a key driver of our outbound engine. You’re a strategic seller who owns the full cycle, thrives on proactive outreach, and isn’t phased by cold calls or pipeline creation. You combine discipline with initiative, independence with collaboration, and urgency with long-term relationship-building. Your territory spans Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, blending short-cycle and long-cycle opportunities. But make no mistake: outbound is the heartbeat of this role. Things you will do: Outreach + engagement : contact leads via email, cold calls, conferences, and more. Manage inbound and referral leads. Lead gen + prospecting: research potential customers, generate leads, and build a consistent outbound sales pipeline. Attend industry events and develop connections to drive future sales growth. Qualification + closing : run discovery calls, demos, and follow-ups to qualify and close new customers. Build proposals and RoI cases that convince qualified prospects to buy Listen. Negotiate contract terms when needed. Process improvement: improve our internal sales processes (slides, call scripts, meeting templates, contract terms, CRM workflows, metrics, dashboards, etc.). Run weekly “Sales Review” meetings company-wide to review deals and answer questions. Cross-team work : work with Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to consistently delight customers. Work with our co-founding team on all things sales and revenue-related. items.description: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. About the Role: We are seeking a driven individual who is passionate about new business acquisition and enterprise sales. As a Corporate Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan within your assigned territory, focusing on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. This role offers the opportunity to work closely with cross-functional teams, including solution engineering (pre-sales), marketing, and professional services, to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success. Candidates must be based in the Greater NYC area to be considered for this role. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a strategic territory plan targeting key organizations and applicable use cases to build a robust pipeline and achieve quarterly and annual sales objectives. Become an expert in our product offerings and industry solutions, delivering compelling demos, presentations, and proposals that clearly articulate business value. Leverage deep knowledge of the market to position our solutions as the best fit for customer needs, highlighting the advantages over competing technologies and approaches. Lead complex sales cycles with a solution-based approach, employing strategic selling strategies and tactics, including the Land & Expand model to grow accounts. Manage the full sales process from prospecting to closing, consistently securing new logos and expanding within existing accounts. Provide guidance and mentorship to Business Development Representatives (BDRs) and Field Marketing resources to align on target accounts and support pipeline development. Maintain accurate and up-to-date information within the CRM system, ensuring data integrity and adhering to forecasting guidelines. Develop strong partnerships with public cloud providers (AWS, Google, Microsoft Azure) and leverage these relationships to drive growth opportunities. What You Bring to the Role: 3+ years of proven success in commercial software sales with a consistent track record of exceeding targets. Demonstrated experience managing complex sales processes within enterprise markets such as Data Warehousing, Business Intelligence, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields. Proven ability to independently develop and close new client relationships while effectively managing long-term business engagements. Deep understanding of commercial open-source business models, including selling on-premise and cloud & SaaS hybrid solutions. Ability to craft and execute sales strategies tailored to specific industries, leveraging partner and Go-to-Market knowledge. Strong presentation, communication, and organizational skills with a knack for building strong business champions. Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDIC, SPIN, or Challenger Sales, and experience working in a fast-paced, competitive market. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver on customer expectations, including Pre-Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Field Engineering resources. Proven ability to build and nurture relationships with key decision-makers, including CTOs, IT leaders, and technical end users, while collaborating with Solution Architects, Professional Services, and Channel Partners. Preferred Qualifications: Experience selling complex technical solutions, with a focus on subscription-based models and cloud deployments. Knowledge of graph technology, data management tools, or other advanced data-driven technologies. A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field and proficiency in standard corporate productivity tools (Google Docs, Salesforce, MS Office). The annual on target earnings range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This range is an estimate, and the actual on target earnings may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range. In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence. Annual On Target Earnings Range $200,000—$240,000 USD Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. items.description: About Object Edge: Object Edge is an AI-native, forward-deployed engineering firm. It builds Hive, a company brain for revenue, embeds engineers to build agentic workflows on it, and provides management engineering to lead the change. Award-winning eCommerce consultancy that delivers end-to-end design and development solutions centered around our client’s goals and customer needs. Our teams unite curious, intellectual advisors across the globe who creatively solve business problems and produce measurable results. About the Position: Senior Data Engineering (Databricks) What You’ll Do • Be a technical leader in teams with minimal oversight and direction to deliver innovative solutions on the Databricks Platform using core cloud data lakehouse methodologies, tools, distributed processing engines, event streaming platforms, and other modern data-related technologies. • Be part of the Databricks Center of Excellence. • Build the next generation of data platforms and work with some of the most forward- thinking organizations in data and analytics. • Work under the direction of a Solution Architect to help design and implement components of our clients’ data platform solution. • Participate in design sessions and be able to break down complex development tasks, and complete development items on time. • Contribute to various COE initiatives to develop Databricks solution accelerators and bring an innovative mindset. Location: Remote - United States What You’ll Bring: As a Senior Engineer in the Databricks practice, you will bring a curious mindset and a passion for exploring innovative solutions to address our clients’ most pressing data challenges. You are a self- starter who excels at breaking down complex problems and eagerly shares insights with your team and the broader Builder community. Key Responsibilities: • Develop and implement data solutions using Databricks, with hands-on experience in specific Databricks platform features such as Delta Lake, Uniform (Iceberg), Delta Live Tables (Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines), and Unity Catalog. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and optimize data pipelines for both batch and streaming data, ensuring data quality and efficiency. • Stay updated with emerging technologies, the latest Databricks platform features, and continuously improve your skills in Databricks and other relevant tools. Experience You’ll Bring: • Strong data engineering experience, with at least 2 years of hands-on data pipeline design and development experience with Databricks, including specific platform features like Delta Lake, Uniform (Iceberg), Delta Live Tables (Lakeflow Declarative pipelines), and Unity Catalog. • Proficiency in designing and building robust, scalable, YAML configuration-driven data pipelines with batch, micro-batch, and streaming data ingestion and processing patterns using tools like Auto Loader, demonstrating a strong understanding of modern data engineering practices.Experienced in building complex job/workflow orchestration patterns using either Databricks jobs/workflows or other orchestration tools like Airflow, dbt etc. • Exposure to building robust data quality, pipeline audit/observability solutions with Databricks native features and/or other data quality tools/frameworks like Great Expectations, Collibra, dbt, etc. • Proficiency in Big Data Platforms: Apache Spark, Presto, Amazon EMR. • Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses: Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, Google BigQuery. • Strong programming skills using SQL, stored procedures, and object-oriented programming languages (like Java, Python, PySpark, etc.). • Familiarity with building DevOps, CI/CD pipelines using Databricks Asset Bundles with automated validation and testing. • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform is a big plus. • Familiarity with NoSQL Databases and Container Management Systems. • Exposure to AI/ML tools (like MLflow), prompt engineering, and modern data and AI agentic workflows. • An ideal candidate will have Databricks Data Engineering Associate and/or Professional certification completed with multiple Databricks project delivery experience. Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience based on department and role. Object Edge provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We believe in providing employees with a work environment free of unlawful discrimination and harassment. In addition to national law requirements, Object Edge complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

items.description: Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture: At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies. We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space. Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you’re developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you. As Solution Architect, Marketing Cloud Next, you will lead the functional solution design for Salesforce Marketing Cloud Next (MC Next) across our client engagements and act as the functional lead within NeuraFlash’s MC Next practice. MC Next is built natively on the Salesforce core platform with Data 360, Flow and Agentforce, so the role combines marketing-platform fluency with data-architecture depth. You understand how marketing teams plan, segment, orchestrate and measure across channels, and you translate that into designs our Data 360, Agentforce and technical teams can build. You will help lead MC Next solutions with key marketing, CRM, data and compliance stakeholders, and internally you will build the reference architectures, reusable patterns and enablement that let the rest of the practice deliver MC Next work with confidence. You’ll have the opportunity to: Lead functional solution design for MC Next grounded in its Data 360 foundation: data model objects, ingestion from CRM and other sources, identity resolution, segmentation, and Actionable Lists, evaluating every requirement against native capability before recommending custom build. Run discovery and design sessions with marketing operations, CRM, data, digital and compliance stakeholders to capture current-state platform capabilities, audience and data architecture, journey complexity, consent models and integration dependencies; present design decisions and trade-offs; and drive open questions to written closure with owners and dates. Design campaign and orchestration architecture using Flow-based orchestration, messaging data sources, activation templates, landing pages and dynamic content for email, SMS and conversational channels, including Handlebars and AMPscript personalization where supported. Design consent and compliance into the platform using the MC Next consent object model, consent records and landing-page consent capture, aligned to regional requirements such as CAN-SPAM, GDPR and CASL, so compliance is built in rather than bolted on. Define platform setup and governance: edition and entitlement selection, Data 360 provisioning, Marketing Data Kit, Business Unit and Data Space structure, permission sets, CMS workspaces, and sending-domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and deliverability planning. Shape agentic marketing solutions with our Agentforce specialists: marketing agents for campaign creation and audience generation, two-way conversational messaging, and predictive AI, with guardrails, approvals and measurement defined up front. Lead migration and coexistence strategy for clients moving from Marketing Cloud Engagement, Account Engagement (Pardot), Marketo, Eloqua, HubSpot or similar platforms: wave sequencing, data and consent-state migration, journey and campaign translation to MC Next-native equivalents, and business-process equivalence checks at UAT. Author and maintain the functional design: data model mappings, process flows, user stories with acceptance criteria and formal design sign-off artifacts, following NeuraFlash’s Navigate Next delivery methodology and accelerators. Translate the design for the build team (Technical Architects, Developers, Data 360 and Agentforce specialists), review configuration against spec, and support UAT and deployment gates. Define what NeuraFlash owns versus what the client must provide (data access, SME availability, environment access, compliance approvals) and hold both sides to it. Help build our MC Next practice: own reference architectures, capture reusable patterns from engagements, contribute to scoping calculators and SOW templates, and co-deliver enablement for the delivery team. Support pre-sales as the MC Next subject-matter expert: discovery calls, solution shaping, demos and estimates (hours and scope; pricing stays with sales leadership), alongside our sales team and Salesforce marketing account teams. Coach and mentor functional and technical team members on MC Next and stay current on Salesforce release changes across Marketing Cloud Next, Data 360 and Agentforce. Required Qualifications 5+ years in marketing automation consulting, marketing-technology solution architecture or business analysis, including hands-on delivery of enterprise marketing automation (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Account Engagement, or a comparable platform such as Braze, Marketo or Eloqua) Hands-on experience with Marketing Cloud Next, or demonstrated ramp-up from Marketing Cloud Engagement or Account Engagement onto MC Next and Data 360 (the platform is new, so we weigh depth of adjacent delivery experience) Working knowledge of Data 360 (Data Cloud) concepts: data model objects, ingestion, identity resolution, segmentation and activation, and how to troubleshoot data hygiene Strong understanding of marketing consent and compliance requirements (CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CASL or similar) and how they shape data model, sharing and preference design Experience designing multi-channel campaigns and orchestration (email, SMS, conversational or push), including personalization and content strategy Practical knowledge of email deliverability: domain authentication, sender reputation and IP warm-up Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, facilitate design decisions with senior marketing and IT stakeholders, and document them to sign-off Experience working alongside Technical Architects and owning functional design through UAT and deployment Ability to tie solution outcomes to business value (conversion, cost to serve, time to launch, attribution) through clear storytelling Comfortable with flow-charting and data-modeling tools (for example Lucidchart) and with agile delivery Willingness to travel to client sites as needed Preferred Skills Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Next Consultant; Data 360 Consultant; Agentforce Specialist; Platform Administrator; and an Application or Solution Architect credential Marketing Cloud Engagement credentials (for example Email Specialist, Consultant) and Account Engagement Specialist, for migration and coexistence work Hands-on experience with Flow Builder, including marketing flows and Agentforce actions Integration experience with Salesforce CRM and external systems (REST APIs, MuleSoft or equivalent) Experience with legacy-to-MC Next migrations, including subscriber, consent and journey migration Experience in a regulated industry (health, financial services, nonprofit) where consent and PHI/PII handling shape marketing design Experience with additional Marketing Cloud tools such as Personalization, Intelligence, Tableau Next or comparable reporting and attribution design What can you expect in the interview process? Recruiter screen (phone), 30 minutes. Introductory conversation to discuss the role and your experience. Practice Lead Interview (video), 45 minutes. You’ll talk through your career goals, relevant marketing platform work examples, and challenges you have overcome and the tools you used to get there. Leadership interview (video), 30 minutes. You’ll meet with a member of our leadership team. What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture? Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you’re one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team. Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don’t mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients. Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small. Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

items.description: this is your role At TradeTracker .com, we are dedicated to delivering innovative software solutions that meet the needs of our clients and drive business growth. We are seeking an experienced Product Development Manager with a strong foundation in Advertising Technology (3+ years) and demonstrated leadership in SaaS product development . Your cover letter must highlight relevant adtech, SaaS, and gamification experience, demonstrating why these make you an exceptional fit for this role. Applications missing this information cannot be processed. Key Responsibilities As a Product Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our product innovation. Your primary responsibility is to ensure that our products are designed and developed to meet the highest standards of quality and performance. You will lead efforts to understand market demands, identify opportunities for improvement, and work with various teams to deliver solutions that enhance our product offerings. You will report directly to the Head of Product, ensuring alignment with overall company goals and strategy. Product Design and Documentation: Actively create and maintain clear, detailed documentation for new products and features, including functional descriptions, flowcharts, and mockups. You will translate complex product ideas into easy-to-understand visuals and written materials, providing a blueprint that guides development and enhances cross-functional understanding. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, data engineers, and product managers, to deliver high-impact products. Your role will involve coordinating efforts across these teams to ensure that product development is seamless and efficient, fostering a collaborative environment. Product-Market Fit: Continuously assess and address client needs to ensure that our products maintain their relevance and effectiveness in the market. This involves staying updated on market trends, gathering client feedback, and making data-driven decisions to refine and improve our products. You will also need to understand SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports to create user-friendly and insightful products. your profile To excel in this role, you need a blend of experience, technical knowledge, and analytical skills. These qualifications will enable you to understand the market, make informed decisions, and drive the development of successful products. Experience: Proven experience as a Product Manager or in a similar role within the advertising or software development fields. You should have a track record of successfully managing and launching products that meet market needs and drive business growth. SaaS Expertise: Good understanding of SaaS interfaces, dashboards, charts, and reports. This expertise is essential for developing user-friendly products that provide valuable insights and drive user engagement. AdTech Knowledge: A deep understanding of the online advertising technology landscape, including customer needs and market dynamics. Experience and knowledge in AdTech and online advertising are crucial. Knowledge and experience with affiliate marketing are a plus. Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze market data, interpret insights, and make informed decisions. This involves using data to prioritize product features, measure performance, and guide the product development process. You should also be comfortable with SaaS analytics and reporting tools to extract meaningful insights. Rapid Prototyping: Knowledge and experience with rapid prototyping techniques to quickly iterate and refine product concepts. This is crucial for fast-paced development cycles and ensuring that ideas are effectively translated into functional designs. We are looking for someone who not only meets the skill requirements but also brings additional qualities that will help drive our success. Your proficiency with tools, experience in scope management, and ability to lead and inspire are critical for this role. Product Management Tools: Proficient in using product management tools and methodologies such as Atlassian Product Discovery. These tools help streamline the product development process, ensure all team members are aligned, and facilitate efficient project management. Scope Management: Experience in transferring scope from Product Management to Product Owners for product development. This skill ensures that product development is focused and efficient, with clear responsibilities and timelines, leading to successful project execution. Wireframing & Prototyping: Familiarity with high-level wireframing and prototyping techniques. This allows you to create initial design concepts that can be tested and refined before full-scale development, ensuring that the final product meets user needs and expectations. Productivity & Quality: We expect high productivity and a work mentality based on productivity-focused work. Your performance should consistently result in high-quality products that are superior to those offered by our competitors. Visionary Thinker: A forward-thinking leader with the ability to inspire people and drive teams toward achieving strategic goals. Your vision and leadership will be crucial in guiding the product development process and achieving business objectives. If you are passionate about AdTech and have the expertise to lead product development in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you.
