Job Description This role is based in Hyderabad and follows a hybrid working model . To be eligible, you must either already be located in Hyderabad or be willing to relocate prior to joining to ensure you can attend the office as required. Join us in shaping the future of document management across a global organisation. As our Document Management Systems Product Leader, you’ll take ownership of a business-critical platform at the heart of how we collaborate, govern information, and meet regulatory obligations. Working within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, you’ll define the strategy, roadmap, and long-term vision for our global Document Management System, driving innovation, adoption, and continuous improvement. This is a high-impact role offering the opportunity to influence senior stakeholders, lead enterprise-wide change, and deliver secure, scalable, and user-centric solutions that support both business growth and digital transformation. What you will do You’ll define and execute the global Document Management System (DMS) strategy, leveraging Microsoft SharePoint Online and the wider Microsoft 365 ecosystem to deliver business value, drive adoption, and support digital transformation across the organisation. You’ll own the end-to-end DMS product lifecycle, managing the roadmap, backlog, service performance, integrations, and continuous improvement while balancing new capabilities with technical debt and operational priorities. You’ll ensure the platform remains secure, compliant, and audit-ready by establishing document retention policies, records management standards, service KPIs, SLAs, and information governance controls within a regulated financial services environment. You’ll collaborate with senior business leaders, technology teams, security, architecture, vendors, and external stakeholders to align outcomes, gain strategic buy-in, support M&A initiatives, and enhance client and colleague experiences. You’ll influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, communicating vision and roadmap effectively, driving adoption of new Microsoft 365 capabilities, and providing confident leadership in fast-paced, high-pressure environments. What we offer Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance. Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance. Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance. Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance. Qualifications You have a degree in an IT-related field and hold Microsoft Power Platform Fundamentals certification, with additional Power Platform or development certifications considered an advantage. You bring extensive experience with SharePoint Online (SPO), Microsoft 365 development, Power Platform environments, Power Apps, Power BI integrations, REST APIs, database design, PowerShell scripting, and application lifecycle management tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira. You have a strong track record of engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, establishing secure document management and external collaboration controls, and delivering solutions in complex, fast-paced business environments. You demonstrate excellent analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to design innovative solutions, manage competing priorities, and drive successful outcomes. You thrive in global, multicultural organizations and communicate fluently in English, bringing the credibility, adaptability, and collaborative mindset needed to succeed in a complex financial services or professional services environment. Additional Information As a forward-looking business, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders, including our employees, clients, and local communities, while also reducing our impact on our natural environment. There is always more we can, and should do, to improve, whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee. Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to colleagues. We want to empower our 5,500+ employees, from 94 nationalities, speaking 41 languages across 25 countries, to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad, we support female managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced. We’re committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth. items.title: Technical Customer Support
items.summary: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. Tools you'll use: Helpscout, our Support Dashboard, Sidekiq, GitHub, Slack, Telegram, MonsterOps, Outline, MxToolbox, Postmark, Bento, TidyCal, Fathom, Visual Code and Claude. Who You Are You build rapport fast. You are warm, positive, and relatable in writing and on calls. You are a good communicator. Externally, you can show warmth, empathy and care. Internally, you are able to communicate clearly and concisely about important things. You can operate with minimal instructions. You understand a short brief without every detail spelled out. You can prioritize well (especially when you have a lot on your plate), and get things done without hand-holding. You are comfortable on video. You are natural on live calls with Zoom and Meet, and on recorded video through tools like Loom. Your teammates can always count on you. You say what you'll do and you do what you said. You act with a constant sense of urgency. You can execute fast and find new ways to improve your productivity. You are resourceful. You use all the tools at your disposal to get great results. You have a low ego. You don't take offense easily and you handle disagreement as a discussion, not a personal attack. Growth mindset. You are positive about new workflow/process/product/tool changes. You love giving and receiving positive and negative feedback without getting defensive. Hours that overlap with East coast US and UK, where most of our customers are. A Plus If You Have Experience with customer facing work, or if you don't have it, tell us why you are perfect for this role. Working knowledge of deliverability and LinkedIn outreach. Warmup, DNS, inbox rotation, DKIM, SPF, Outlook and Gmail technical setup. We can teach this, but a head start helps. Comfort with agency setups. Workspaces, guest seats, inbox purchases and what happens when an agency loses a client. Light data skills. You can pull numbers from Help Scout or our MCP to back up what you report. An eye for happy customers. You notice them and ask for testimonials and case studies at the right moment. How We Work Together You'll work directly with the founder and with our lead developer. Working with the founder can be intense. Here is what that looks like in practice: Replies are short and can come across as harsh. If something written lands badly or isn't clear, ask. Direction can change. The founder may say one thing, then something different a few days later as they learn more. When that happens, check what changed and adapt. Information should be short and to the point. Lead with what matters, then give more details if asked. The founder can stay frustrated about a problem until it's solved. That's something they are aware of and working on. You'll do well here if you can stay calm and focused when the pressure is on. The team often thinks fast and interrupts each other when discussing ideas. If that would bother you, this role probably isn't for you. This role suits someone with high emotional intelligence, who doesn't take things personally, asks when something is unclear, and keeps many things moving at once. Your schedule can be flexible. If you have a martial arts class every Thursday at 3 pm, go and make up the time later. In return, on the rare occasion the team needs your help on a weekend, we ask you to be flexible too. Benefits Contract type: full-time or part-time Compensation: $2,500 to $4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and location. US-based hires will work as independent contractors (1099). Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! About the Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live. You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Be the main technical contact after go-live Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live. Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior. Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support. Support technical incident management Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues. Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams. Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up. Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely. Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required. Drive merchant technical improvements Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost. Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth. Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch. Build merchant health visibility Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants. Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks. Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally. Requirements 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles. Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS. Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support. Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline. Fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must. Startup environment experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks. The TAM should help ensure that: Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly. Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership. Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication. Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts. Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA. \n \n What will you find when you join DEUNA? - A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM - Dynamism, agility and constant innovation - Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region - The best tools and technology to operate - Being part of the startup culture. - We are in full expansion! items.description: Product Headquarters: Hidalgo del Parral, Chihuahua, Mexico URL: https://customer.io About Customer.io Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data. About the role Hi, my name is Megan Berry, Senior Director of Product at Customer.io , and I'm looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us turn customer signals into products people actually want. Our team is six product managers who partner closely with Design and Engineering to launch first-class products that drive customer and business outcomes. You need to be able to synthesize customer research, market research, analytics and your own taste into a customer-first roadmap and set of releases. You will work with a cross-functional team with a high level of autonomy to validate ideas early and help the team ship excellent work. This role focuses on Workflows. What we value Surfacing customer problems based on qualitative and quantitative data. Driving alignment through effective communication. Performing market research and presenting findings. Using AI to accelerate discovery. Helping our teams ship sooner. What you’ll do Identify and validate customer problems through user research, usage analytics, partner insights, and AI-powered discovery tools. Rapidly prototype and run focused experiments to test hypotheses and de-risk new ideas early in development. Lead cross-functional planning by aligning Engineering, Design, and business stakeholders around clear product goals and trade-offs. Drive feature strategy and influence roadmaps by proposing initiatives rooted in customer impact and market opportunity. Break down complex projects into incremental, testable releases, using component reuse and system thinking to accelerate delivery. Define product success metrics upfront and track adoption, engagement, and retention to inform iterative improvement. Take on Technology Lead responsibilities for specific initiatives when needed, including data analysis, prototyping, coordinating engineering work, and managing delivery risks. Look at product metrics after launch and work with GTM stakeholders to ensure your launches are successful and create the product and business outcomes we want. What we're looking for 7+ years of product management experience, ideally including time in B2B SaaS or platforms that leverage behavioral data for automation or messaging. Strong analytical skills, comfort with metrics dashboards, and experience using data to shape direction and evaluate impact. Proven ability to lead feature development independently, reduce scope, and deliver successful outcomes with tight teams. High product intuition balanced with humility and experimentation. You're comfortable being wrong and eager to learn quickly. Exceptional written communication and decision-framing abilities, especially in remote and async-first environments. Experience using or developing AI-powered tooling in your product workflow. Technical background with demonstrated ability to build basic web applications, write scripts, and work with engineering teams on topics such as data models, APIs, and performance requirements. Track record of serving as a point of contact or DRI for engineering initiatives, with the ability to choose objectives and navigate trade-offs. Experience with products that involve complex workflows or automations is a plus. Compensation & Benefits We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $170k–$200k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment. Zone 1: $204k–$240k USD Zone 2: $187k–$220k USD Zone 3: $170k–$200k USD We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family . We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO , stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more. See full benefits here → Our Process No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter 30-minute video call with the Hiring Manager 60-minute Engineering working session (Product case, Part 1) 60-minute Product case presentation with the Product team and Hiring Manager (Part 2) All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process. Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact. Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io . Join us! Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/customer-io-senior-product-manager-workflows

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. items.summary: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch
items.description: About Life360 Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com. Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team The AI Platforms team builds the shared foundation that lets Life360 use AI quickly and safely: model access and routing, MCP gateway and connectors, the agent runtime and orchestration platform, memory and knowledge infrastructure, evals and observability, and cost controls. We work alongside AI Dev Tooling and Agentic PDLC, the teams reshaping how Life360 builds with agents, and we’re extending the same foundations to power AI features for our members. About the Job The AI Platforms team at Life360 builds the shared foundation that enables the rapid and safe use of AI across the organization. This includes model access and routing, the MCP gateway and connectors, the agent runtime and orchestration platform, memory and knowledge infrastructure, evaluations and observability, as well as cost controls. As an AI Platform Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing the infrastructure that supports every engineer and agent at Life360, extending it from internal productivity to member-facing product features. In this role, you will own production components end to end, setting the technical direction for your area and transforming early momentum into established pathways that other teams will adopt. You are a builder at heart, responsible for shipping code, reviewing designs, and making pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions as the model and tooling landscape evolves. You will collaborate closely with the AI Dev Tooling and Agentic PDLC teams, which are reshaping how Life360 builds with agents, while also extending the same foundational capabilities to power AI features for our members. You will report to the Director of AI Platforms. The US-based salary range for this position is $149,000 to $271,500 USD. We take into consideration an individual’s background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) _, as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits._ What You’ll Do Establish the overarching vision and paved paths that enable teams across Life360 to adopt AI-native engineering best practices Build the agent runtime and orchestration platform, including identity, authorization, and audit for scheduled and unattended agents Operate the MCP gateway and connector infrastructure: secure brokering so agents reach internal data, APIs, repos, and SaaS tools through managed, auditable connections rather than unmanaged direct access Support the LLM gateway: model access and routing, authentication, rate limits, token budgets, and per-team cost attribution Build eval and regression infrastructure: golden datasets, offline evals, CI hooks, and result storage, with quality regression treated as a first-class alert Setup observability: prompt and response tracing, cost per request, quality signals, and drift detection Work with Security, Privacy, and Legal to build data handling, tenant isolation, and auditability into the platform from day one Define how product teams access, run, and monitor AI inference in production at member scale: serving, latency, reliability, and provider management Own what you build in production: SLOs, dashboards, deployment pipelines, and incident response Enable memory, retrieval, and knowledge infrastructure that agents can share Make the right way the easy way: SDKs, templates, reusable skills, docs, and internal champions that engineers and their agents choose to use Partner with AI DevX and Agentic PDLC to turn their needs into shared primitives instead of one-off builds Mentor engineers on agent architecture and evaluation rigor, and write design docs and standards other teams can build against Explore foundational memory, retrieval, and shared knowledge capabilities for agents as longer-term platform needs evolve What We’re Looking For 8+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years building platforms or infrastructure used by other engineers Experience building and operating production AI systems, such as agentic workflows, LLM integrations, retrieval, and evaluation Working knowledge of MCP and agent orchestration, including how agents connect to internal systems with appropriate controls Strong backend and cloud fundamentals: distributed systems, APIs, infrastructure as code, and reliability and observability practices Experience running AI inference in production, including latency, reliability, provider management, and cost tradeoffs Sound judgment on what deserves a shared platform investment and what doesn’t Clear written communication: design docs and standards precise enough for other engineers (and their agents) to build against Bonus Experience Experience with non-human identity, service-account, or agent authZ models Experience building or operating an agent orchestration or deployment platform, or an MCP-style connector gateway Familiarity with SOC 2, GDPR, or similar compliance frameworks Background in ML infrastructure or model observability Experience with consumer-scale products or privacy-sensitive data AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here’s what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you’d give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on and help teammates earlier in their AI workflow adoption get up to speed. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team when something would meaningfully improve how we work. Our Benefits Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees) Paid parental leave 401(k) plan with company matching program Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns Learning & Development programs Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers AI Usage: We use AI to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Life360 hiring teams Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Belonging Life360 is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected status. We believe diverse perspectives make us better, and we’re building a workplace that reflects the communities we serve. Don’t meet every qualification? Apply anyway. #LI-Remote ____________________________________________________________________________

In this role, you will partner closely with hiring managers to focus on providing a remarkable candidate experience, lead with data when consulting on business decisions, leverage AI tools, drive an interview process that evaluates candidates against our client’s high bar for performance, and bring a growth mindset to ensure we hire remarkable and diverse talent at scale. This role will require problem-solving in teams, so experience and interest in collaborating with others to drive meaningful solutions are essential for success. Ability to manage priorities with some ambiguity and consistently deliver in line with business goals. Comfort working with data, dashboards, and KPIs to influence decisions and measure success. Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset — embracing change, learning fast, and taking action with urgency. Comfort with AI-powered recruiting tools and openness to experimenting with new technologies. Additional Information This is a temporary, full-time contract position with an expected duration of 6-9 months. Candidates must be located in Ireland.

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: United States URL: http://www.halcyon.ai What we do: Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware. Who we are: Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers. As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs. The Role At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust. You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows. Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence. Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows. Skills and Qualifications 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase. A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration. Strong understanding of APIs, messaging systems (Kafka), and modern data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, OpenSearch). Experience building services in a cloud-native environment, preferably AWS. Working knowledge of containers and Kubernetes. Comfortable working in a remote-first, asynchronous team environment. Bonus Skills and Qualifications Familiarity with functional programming patterns and idiomatic Scala. Experience with Databricks and ClickHouse (or similar lakehouse and analytical/OLAP data stores). Experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitHub Actions. Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch). Prior work on security products, data pipelines, or high-availability systems. Python development experience, particularly with security analysis tools and malware detection frameworks (YARA, PE analysis, binary analysis). Familiarity with machine learning workflows, AutoML, and MLflow for model deployment and management. Experience with binary analysis libraries (LIEF, ssdeep, TLSH) and security tooling integration. Benefits: Halcyon offers the following benefits to eligible employees: Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, and vision) with premiums paid in full for employees and dependents. 401k plan with a generous employer contribution. Short and long-term disability coverage, basic life and AD&D insurance plans. Medical and dependent care FSA options. Flexible PTO policy. Parental leave. Generous equity offering. The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​ Base Salary Range : $120,000 - $170,000 Bonus Target: 10% In accordance with applicable state and federal laws, the range provided is Halcyon’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Base pay is one part of the total package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and equity in the Company. We understand it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, passionate, curious, and creative people to develop the exceptional product we are building. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity employer. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/halcyon-senior-backend-cloud-engineer

items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Canada (Remote) About the Role: An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human. We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics. Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences. Our Core Technologies Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools. What You'll Do • Journey creation: Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout • Optimization: Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge • Edge case handling: Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff • Containment: Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most • Product partnership: Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs • Safety and compliance: Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers • Handoffs: Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context • Testing: Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior • Monitoring: Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts • Voice tuning: Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone • Sierra relationship: Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks What We Look For: • 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles • Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails • Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates • Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms. • Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved • Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response • Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal Nice To Have: • Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect) • Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling • Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design • Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2) • Conversation design or UX writing experience What We Offer You: • Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance • Flexible PTO • Opportunities for professional growth and development • Paid parental leave • Health & wellness initiatives To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-ai-experience-engineer-conversational-ai
