items.description: Description Location : 100% remote (EMEA) Classification : Full-time Pay Range : 82.000€ to 140.000€ - determined by several factors, including location Miaplaza is dedicated to making education engaging and accessible through innovative online learning platforms. We develop personalized learning experiences for students, helping them grow in a supportive and interactive environment. Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive education curriculum platform where all students can be successful! As an engineering manager at Miaplaza, your team will build technology with a direct impact on the lives of hundreds of thousands of students. Every step of the way, you will have the opportunity to influence our direction. Through our platforms, we create engaging, safe, and thoughtfully designed learning experiences that help children grow academically, creatively, and personally. Every feature we ship, every system we scale, and every improvement we make contributes to shaping how the next generation learns and discovers their potential. If our platform is down, a child might not go to school that day. We’re looking for leaders who want their work to matter in classrooms and homes, who care about access to quality education, and who are excited to craft technology that makes a difference in young people’s lives. Here, your impact doesn’t just power a product; it shapes future generations! What you’ll work on : We’re moving everything towards GCP and Kubernetes. We’re growing towards a scale that no longer matches our legacy architecture and actively investing in modernization. We’re migrating on-premise workloads to GKE, strengthening security and business continuity best practices, and moving toward platform self-service for our development teams. A core goal is to consolidate and shrink the stack, and every migration decision is measured against whether it lowers the daily burden on the team. You’ll need to work with your team balancing both platform initiatives and the operational needs of the engineering teams you serve. You’ll report to our head of engineering and be expected to split your time roughly 50 ⁄ 50 between people management and hands-on development. Prioritization always goes to leading and supporting your engineers. Your team will consist of four engineers. What’s unique about management at Miaplaza: Miaplaza is a US-based education company, which means we probably are doing things differently than you’ve done in your past experience. Here are a few differences you may notice: You will first onboard within your team as a senior engineer for 2 months. You will start to onboard as a manager during month two and will take over the team roughly at 10 weeks. This is non-negotiable as both periods of time are equally important. We expect our EMs to spend approximately 50% of their time hands-on, even after they’ve completed onboarding as a senior engineer. We emphasize the importance of pedagogical principles. A responsibility is to grow your engineers and those around you. One of such pedagogical principles is that we expect you to have full oversight into your direct reports’ work; you can’t properly teach if you don’t see the process behind the output. Feedback is the norm. You’ll be expected to give meaningful, specific reinforcement and constructive feedback whenever you notice something. You should also expect to receive feedback. Ultimately, everything we do is optimizing ourselves, our teams, our processes, and our company to best support our students. Requirements Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 2+ years of experience being a mentor/leader, of which: 1+ years leading a team, formally or as a tech lead 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering, of which: 3+ years running production workloads on Kubernetes (GKE preferred) 3+ years of experience with a major cloud provider and Infrastructure as Code. GCP is our primary cloud and we expect senior-level knowledge of IAM, networking, KMS, GKE, CloudSQL and Secret Manager 3+ years of experience operating at a Senior, Staff, or Principal Engineer level. Experience with CI/CD pipeline design and operations Experience with GitOps (FluxCD or ArgoCD) Experience working directly with engineering teams and other managers as your customers on scoping and prioritization Experience leading incident response, including running postmortems What makes you stand out: Experience leading a team through a significant architectural migration Experience with consumer platforms at scale Experience building in regulated environments Experience operating self-hosted observability stacks (Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Grafana, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling Experience supporting .NET/C# application deployments Experience with database operations (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ) Experience with Istio or other service meshes Responsibilities Work with your team to design, build, and operate the infrastructure the rest of engineering depends on: clusters, pipelines, databases, edge, and observability Your customers are the other engineering teams. Work with the other Engineering Managers and product development leadership to scope and prioritize platform work Set the quality bar for your team. Lead by example. Manage, lead, and mentor your team while working side by side with them in code quality, clean infrastructure-as-code, soft skills, best practices, etc Lead team trainings, set SMART goals, hold performance reviews, and provide individual feedback recurrently to each of your devs Our hiring process As a remote company, we receive a large number of applicants, and finding the best fit for this role is our top priority — that’s why our process is longer than usual. At every stage, we try to be respectful of your time and grateful you’re spending it with us. Application and CV Review - Our team will review your application responses and CV, then follow up with an update. Initial Technical Screen (20 minutes) - A quick screening call to answer some administrative questions and confirm your basic technical knowledge. You’ll be asked some administrative questions and 7 short technical questions related to the role. Behavioral Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of our HR team to discuss your experience and share your approach throughout your career so far. 1st Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team to answer focused technical questions tailored to our work. Scenario-based Technical Interview (1 hour) - Meet with a member of the Infrastructure team and the team’s engineering manager to work through two hypothetical DevOps scenarios and how you would tackle them. Leadership Interview (1 hour) - With our head of engineering and executive leadership. Reference check - We’ll reach out to the 3 references you provided, at least one being a former or current manager and any former or current direct reports. Offer & background check - Once you sign your offer, we’ll run a background check in accordance with applicable law. We give honest, timely feedback at every step. Job searches are hard; we don’t want to make yours harder. Compensation and setup The pay range for this role is €82,000 - 140,000. Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering regional differences in labor costs. Placement within a range is determined based on factors such as demonstrated skills, internal equity, and local labor market rates for the candidate’s geographic area. items.summary: About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains.
items.description: About the Role We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment. What You’ll Do Design and execute research on multilingual datasets , including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design) Research and improve cross-lingual transfer , alignment, and robustness in large language models Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate Translate research insights into practical improvements in production models What We’re Looking For Strong background in NLP / ML research , with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.) Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages Solid understanding of: Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.) Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment Nice to Have Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling Experience training or evaluating large language models Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA) Why Join Us Real ownership over research direction and impact A team that values papers and production Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage Originally posted on Himalayas

You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. items.title: Content Reviewer - United States
items.summary: We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit. A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform. By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself. Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies. Service Rates The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines. Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Qualification path Qualification Process No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process. Basic Requirements • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English • Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States • Active use of Gmail and social media platforms • Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection • Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher) • Access to a personal computer Assessment You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

items.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role. The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy. About the Role Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including: Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands Skincare and beauty Tech and software Finance and investing Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability Education Home improvement Automobiles and motorcycles Health and wellness Medical and clinical fields Digital marketing SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply. Responsibilities Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team Qualifications Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content Portfolio featuring published work preferred Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred Compensation Writers are paid on a per-word basis. items.title: 3D Spatial Data Expert (AI Community)
items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. Independent Contractor Relationship This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: Federal Budget Analyst Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Federal Budget Analysts to contribute to a customer's project focused on budget formulation and execution within the federal sector.
items.description: Role Title: Federal Budget Analyst Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Federal Budget Analysts to contribute to a customer's project focused on budget formulation and execution within the federal sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. Scope of Work Create realistic training examples of federal budget justification materials, including narratives, exhibits, and supporting analyses. Write sample responses to OMB passback with clear, well-supported analysis, and annotate the reasoning behind each choice. Document mid-year reprogramming scenarios, noting which actions require higher-level approval and how they stay consistent with spend plans. Build worked examples that compare actual expenditures against planned obligations, evaluate fund availability, and explain variances. Walk through year-end closeout step by step, including reconciliation with accounting records and resolution of discrepancies. Write guidance on funding types, budget changes, and compliance requirements, drawing on how experienced analysts advise program managers. Produce templates, process walkthroughs, and annotated examples that capture how federal budget work is actually done. Review AI-generated budget content for accuracy, realism, and compliance, and explain what is wrong or missing so it can be corrected. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of federal budget experience at about the GS-11/12 level or higher, in GS-0560, 0501, 0510, or comparable roles. Experience with budget formulation, execution, and funds control. Experience with OMB submissions, reprogramming, and year-end closeout. Familiarity with federal accounting and budget execution systems. Financial management certification (DoD FM, CGFM, or similar) a plus. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) Role Type: ContractorLocation: Remotemicro1 is engaging Materials Scientists (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) to contribute specialized expertise to a customer’s project focused on advanced nanomaterial evaluation.
items.description: Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) Role Type: Contractor Location: Remote micro1 is engaging Materials Scientists (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) to contribute specialized expertise to a customer’s project focused on advanced nanomaterial evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The engagement emphasizes independent expert analysis — including manual image thresholding, calibration, and morphology assessments — without reliance on automated or AI-powered tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to document findings, interpret complex micrographs, and convey critical decisions to project stakeholders. Scope of Work Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams Preferred Qualifications Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Global AI Expert & Evaluator
items.summary: TELUS Digital is building a global community of experts to evaluate, challenge and improve advanced AI systems.
items.description: TELUS Digital is building a global community of experts to evaluate, challenge and improve advanced AI systems . We are looking for university students, graduates, researchers and experienced professionals with expertise across Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, LLMs, Mathematics, Science, Engineering, Linguistics, Cybersecurity, Psychology, Law, Healthcare, Finance, Education and other specialist disciplines. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Australia URL: https://zandahealth.com/eu/ Paid Media Coordinator Are you someone who loves building relationships, spotting new opportunities, and bringing great ideas to life? We're looking for a Paid Media Coordinator to help grow Zanda's reach and connect more health professionals with the tools they need to run successful practices. In this hands-on role, you'll manage our advertising, sponsorship, and association partnerships across international markets. From discovering new opportunities to promote Zanda and negotiating great deals to coordinating the deliverables and measuring their impact, you'll play an important part in how we grow. You'll work within our Marketing team while having the autonomy to make things happen. What You’ll Be Doing Build and own relationships with associations, publishers, media partners, agencies, and vendors across our key international markets. Identify and pursue new opportunities for advertising, sponsorships, and partnerships that increase Zanda's brand awareness and reach. Evaluate and negotiate advertising opportunities, securing competitive rates, valuable placements, and partnerships that deliver results. Coordinate campaigns from start to finish, working with internal teams and external partners to keep creative assets, approvals, tracking, and deadlines on track. Manage Programmatic Advertising across channels such as Paid Social and Display, and support opportunities in Paid Search and emerging advertising platforms. Manage campaign operations, including advertising calendars, budgets, pipelines, and vendor coordination. Track and evaluate performance, using campaign data and insights to identify what's working, recommend improvements, and maximize the value of our advertising investments. What You’ll Bring to the Team 2-3+ years of relevant experience in marketing, media, partnerships, sponsorships, or campaign management. Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with external partners, vendors, agencies, or stakeholders. Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-marketing-coordinator-paid-media

We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll play a key role in driving new business growth by acquiring net-new customers for Gong Foundations. You will own and manage the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations. Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects. Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly. Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program. QUALIFICATIONS Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office. 6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial. Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred. Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads. Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus. PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Monthly stipend to help make your work from home days more comfortable. The annual OTE for this position is $130,000 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. If you are a quota-crushing salesperson who excels at running sophisticated product demonstrations, articulating clear business value, and closing new logos, this is the perfect opportunity to make a significant impact at a high-growth company. Responsibilities: Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual sales quotas. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from initial discovery and product demonstration to contract negotiation and close. Become an expert in the Eulerity platform, articulating its business value and ROI to marketing VPs, Directors, and franchise owners. Partner with your assigned Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build a robust pipeline and convert qualified opportunities. Generate self-sourced opportunities through your own targeted prospecting and relationship-building. Maintain a meticulous and accurate forecast of your pipeline and sales activity in our CRM (Hubspot). Collaborate with Customer Success, Product, and Marketing teams to ensure a smooth client handoff and provide valuable market feedback. Requirements: 4-7 years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience, with a demonstrable track record of exceeding quota. At least 3 years of experience selling ad-tech, mar-tech, or digital marketing solutions. Proven experience navigating and closing deals with mid-market, multi-location, or franchise businesses. A sophisticated understanding of the digital marketing ecosystem, including paid search, social media, display, and analytics. Exceptional communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. A self-motivated, ambitious, and highly organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency with modern sales tools (e.g., Hubspot, Apollo, Salesforce). Eligibility: This position is remote, but applicants must reside within the United States. Preferred Skills: A competitive spirit and a desire to be part of a winning team. An entrepreneurial mindset with a willingness to help build and refine processes. Formal sales methodology training (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger Sale). Benefits: 🩺 Comprehensive benefits Medical Dental Vision 🏖️ Unlimited PTO 🍼 Paid Parental Leave 📈 401(k) with company match ⌨️ Access to world-class AI tools [Claude, Gemini, HubSpot AI, ZoomInfo AI, Etc] 💻 Remote Compensation: Our base salary range is between USD $100,000 - $125,000 (potential to earn significant commission on top of base salary) which is based on paying competitively for our company’s size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes benefits, perks and other opportunities at Eulerity. This role is also eligible for a competitive commission plan. ***************************************************************************** IMPORTANT 🛑 _ PLEASE FILL THIS FORM TO COMPLETE YOUR APPLICATION _ *****************************************************************************

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives cus
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, USA Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions. Why you'll love this role StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform. This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise. The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale. This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. You will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to define and accelerate the path to liquidity, engagement, and monetization within your category. What You’ll Do Category Strategy & Ownership Define the strategic vision and growth plan for your category on the platform Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance Supply & Community Acquisition Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance Category Performance & Analytics Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Culture & Community Leadership Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth About you Experienced GTM / Growth Operator: 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred Strategic Thinker + Doer: Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Relationship-Driven: Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners Data Fluent: Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters Community Minded: Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement Nice to Have Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops) Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics Why This Role Matters As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will: Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary. About StockX StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stockx-category-manager

items.description: About Object Edge: Object Edge is an AI-native, forward-deployed engineering firm. It builds Hive, a company brain for revenue, embeds engineers to build agentic workflows on it, and provides management engineering to lead the change. Award-winning eCommerce consultancy that delivers end-to-end design and development solutions centered around our client’s goals and customer needs. Our teams unite curious, intellectual advisors across the globe who creatively solve business problems and produce measurable results. About the Position: Senior Architect Data Engineer (Databricks) What You’ll Do • Collaborate closely with data leaders to drive sales, recruiting, account management, consulting, and operational excellence across the practice • Be part of our growing Databricks Center of Excellence and focus on leading on Databricks projects. • Act as a Databricks SME, supporting business development efforts and guiding clients through best practices in architecture, data engineering, and scalable analytics • Drive innovation and performance through a team-based approach that values output, ownership, and employee wellbeing • Lead and manage project risk—including planning, budgeting, deliverables, and executive-level alignment • Deepen Slalom’s presence in the market by developing proposals, SOWs, and strategies to grow our footprint within existing accounts • Provide technical and architectural guidance on Databricks, modern data platforms, and cloud-native solutions to both clients and Slalom team members • Be a mentor and thought leader, regularly recommending emerging technologies and tools that align with client goals and future-state data strategies • Bring a business-first lens to every conversation, driving impactful, tech-enabled outcomes that elevate our clients’ competitive edge. Location: Remote - Brazil What You’ll Bring: As a Senior Architect in the Databricks practice, you will bring your broad experience in architecture design and deep expertise in data engineering to tackle the most complex data challenges for our clients. You are a visionary leader who can drive strategic initiatives and foster an environment of innovation. Key Responsibilities: • Develop and oversee large-scale data architecture projects, leveraging Databricks and its specific platform features such as Delta Lake, Unform (Iceberg), Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog to deliver high-impact solutions. • Provide leadership and strategic direction to engineering teams, ensuring alignment with client objectives, and maximizing the use of Databricks’ features. • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding them through digital transformation and data strategy development, with a focus on leveraging Databricks to its fullest potential. • Serve complex Databricks implementation sales/pre-sales pursuits in the capacity of Sales Solution Lead/Lead Architect crafting tailored proposals based on client needs. • Lead large Databricks migration/modernization delivery engagements as a Delivery Solution Lead leading a team of data architects and engineers. Experience You’ll Bring: •Strong experience in data engineering or architecture, and extensive hands-on experience with Databricks, including specific products like Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Unity Catalog. • Mastery of Big Data Platforms, Cloud Data Warehouses, and Object-Oriented Programming. • Expertise in NoSQL Databases, Container Management Systems, and AI/ML tools. • Overall understanding of different Databricks platform and governance capabilities to drive design of customized, tailored data platform solution meeting client business needs. • Bring in deep, demonstratable industry experience in designing data & AI platform solution delivery enabling business value delivery. • Experience in delivering large scale migration, modernization initiative from legacy Data Warehouses to Databricks Lakehouse platform. • An ideal candidate will have Databricks Data Engineering Professional ceritification completed with experience in leading multiple complex Databricks project delivery experience. Compensation: Salary is commensurate with experience based on department and role. Object Edge provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We believe in providing employees with a work environment free of unlawful discrimination and harassment. In addition to national law requirements, Object Edge complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

items.title: Senior Account Manager at B-Stock
items.summary: JOB SUMMARY As a Senior Account Manager on the Strategic Account Management team, you’ll own the retention and growth of a complex, high-value book of B-Stock’s enterprise General Merchandise retailers and manufacturers. You’ll know each client’s business well enough to advise their operations and returns leaders, not just your day-to-day contact.
items.description: JOB SUMMARY As a Senior Account Manager on the Strategic Account Management team, you’ll own the retention and growth of a complex, high-value book of B-Stock’s enterprise General Merchandise retailers and manufacturers. You’ll know each client’s business well enough to advise their operations and returns leaders, not just your day-to-day contact. You’ll forecast the impact of changes before you make them and bring new GMV opportunities to existing accounts. Newer AMs will come to you for help. You’ll also lead how the team uses AI, building repeatable, increasingly automated approaches to account analysis, client reporting and portfolio planning. This is a hybrid role based in our Boston office (Tu-Th), where training also takes place. ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Exceed GMV and recovery targets across a complex, higher-value book of enterprise accounts Build 2 to 4 quarter account plans tied to each client’s business goals, not just B-Stock metrics, and find net-new inventory and GMV opportunities within existing accounts Forecast account outcomes and model the impact of changes before recommending them, such as auction cadence, lot configuration or category splits, using Tableau, Salesforce and comparable-account data Segment buyers, spot demand patterns others miss, and use data to make the case for strategy changes in client QBRs Partner with client operations teams to improve how inventory flows to market, including manifest standards, grading accuracy, lot building strategy (by category, condition or brand) and fulfillment design Advise clients on where inventory should flow, in what condition and at what cadence, based on their upstream sources (DC returns, overstock and shelf-pulls, customer returns, seasonal clearance) Make non-obvious marketplace recommendations, including when to push back on a client’s instinct, grounded in how B-Stock buyer competition and demand actually behave Build AI-enabled workflows for core portfolio work, including account reviews, performance reporting, client communications and opportunity identification Be the go-to resource for newer AMs: teach the platform, share effective AI workflows, and help peers get unstuck in ambiguous situations Work across Client Ops, Logistics, Velocity and Product without needing escalation, and speak up when a process or decision isn’t working MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, AND ABILITIES 5+ years of professional experience in account management, category management or a similar client-facing commercial role, managing a book of enterprise accounts against revenue or growth targets Working knowledge of retail operations, returns, liquidation or supply chain, enough to connect a client’s operational decisions to commercial outcomes Strong analytical skills: you can build a forecast or scenario model and turn it into a client recommendation Experience with Salesforce and a BI tool (Tableau, Metabase or similar) Hands-on experience applying AI in account management, sales or client reporting workflows, beyond one-off prompting Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace for client-ready materials Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, including leading QBRs with senior client stakeholders Sound judgment with incomplete information Occasional travel to client sites in the US (under 10%) PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience with General Merchandise liquidation or secondary markets, including the factors that move ASP: category mix, condition accuracy, MSRP ratios, brand concentration, pallet vs. truckload sizing, and manifested vs. unmanifested inventory Experience building automations or multi-step agentic workflows with AI assistants (e.g., Claude) connected to CRM and BI tools Contract negotiation experience Advanced Tableau skills; familiarity with Atlassian tools The pay rate for this role will range between $85,000 to $110,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity. EMPLOYEE BENEFITS Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K) Support for continuing education Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts THE COMPANY B-Stock is the world’s largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses. While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory. We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time. Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come. For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/ OUR VALUES Make Each Dollar Count Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us. Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves). Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals. Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed. Find Strength In Numbers Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers. No applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” B-Stock also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at B-Stock. Work Authorization required.

items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The OpportunityAs a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Background in polling and election modeling — for example, FiveThirtyEight during its ABC/ESPN era, Decision Desk HQ, VoteHub, or similar outlets; data-journalism experience of this kind, including at spinoffs such as Fifty Plus One, is also relevant. Prior work on a political trading desk, or standing as a super-user of political prediction apps. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. Familiarity with content policy, moderation frameworks, or editorial standards, particularly around politically sensitive content. Originally posted on Himalayas
